text: Childminder here, long day. One of mine, 4 yr old boy, his eczema's flared right up since yesterday, dry itchy patches behind his knees and in the crooks of his elbows, he keeps scratching. Also snotty nose, blocked one minute and running the next, sneezing non stop. Parents are on a late shift and asked me to check what to do overnight. Can I put more of his usual cream on or is there something better for when it's this bad. I'm shattered tbh
